name: Offer the real captive through native diplomacy and classify AI acceptance and returned spy

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.eventTurn==23 and d.mode=='UNAVAILABLE_CAPACITY' and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1 and d.occupied==1 and d.capacity==1,'actual captive checkpoint differs'); return b.BeginCaptiveExchange()

local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; assert(b.CaptiveExchangeState().stage=='SESSION_OPEN','native captive session did not open'); b.Queue('MARK_CAPTIVE_EXCHANGE'); return 'native captive attempt receipt queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_MARK_CAPTIVE_EXCHANGE' or a=='UNKNOWN_MARK_CAPTIVE_EXCHANGE' or a=='REJECTED_MARK_CAPTIVE_EXCHANGE' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_MARK_CAPTIVE_EXCHANGE'

local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local s=b.CaptiveExchangeState().stage; return s=='AI_ACCEPTED_EXACT' or s=='AI_REFUSED' or s=='AI_CHANGED_TERMS' or s=='AI_RESPONSE_UNCLASSIFIED' or s=='DEAL_INVALID' or s=='DEAL_VALIDATION_UNKNOWN' or b.CaptiveExchangeReplyWaitElapsed(30)

steps.code: local r=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.CaptiveExchangeReplyDiagnostic(); assert(r.sessionMatches,'native captive session changed during AI reply wait'); assert(r.stage=='AI_ACCEPTED_EXACT' or r.stage=='AI_REFUSED' or r.stage=='AI_CHANGED_TERMS' or r.stage=='AI_RESPONSE_UNCLASSIFIED' or r.stage=='DEAL_INVALID' or r.stage=='DEAL_VALIDATION_UNKNOWN','native AI reply remains unobserved, pending or unreadable after one formal proposal'); return r.stage
local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local s=b.CaptiveExchangeState().stage; if s=='AI_ACCEPTED_EXACT' then return b.AcceptCaptiveExchange() end; return s

condition.code: local s=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.CaptiveExchangeState().stage; return s=='RETURNED_MAP_READY' or s=='RETURNED_MAP_WAIT_NATIVE' or s=='RETURNED_OFF_MAP' or s=='AI_REFUSED' or s=='AI_CHANGED_TERMS' or s=='AI_RESPONSE_UNCLASSIFIED' or s=='DEAL_INVALID' or s=='DEAL_VALIDATION_UNKNOWN' or s=='FINAL_REFUSED'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local s=b.CaptiveExchangeState(); local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); if s.stage=='RETURNED_MAP_READY' or s.stage=='RETURNED_MAP_WAIT_NATIVE' or s.stage=='RETURNED_OFF_MAP' then assert(#d.roster.captured==0 and (d.mode=='MAP' or d.mode=='RETURN') and d.occupied==1 and d.spyID==655368,'native captive did not return as the original living spy'); if s.stage=='RETURNED_MAP_READY' then assert(s.operationReady,'returned spy has no official operation') else assert(not s.operationReady,'native operation readiness classification changed') end else assert(d.mode=='UNAVAILABLE_CAPACITY' and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.captive.captor==1 and d.occupied==1 and d.capacity==1,'refused captive offer changed the native roster') end; assert(b.CloseCaptiveExchangeSession()==s.stage,'native deal session classification changed'); return s.stage
